tasks.title: Build salt-relay-api Cloudflare Worker & D1 schema/migrations
tasks.notes: Built server/db.ts, server/crypto.ts (AES-GCM), server/zernio.ts, server/drive.ts, server/distribution.ts, server/queue.ts, server.ts, and worker/index.ts.

tasks.title: Build GitHub Actions media processing & release rotation workflow
tasks.notes: Created .github/workflows/process-media.yml and scripts/process-media-runner.cjs. Created initial GitHub Release media-001.

tasks.title: Build mobile-first functional React dashboard UI
tasks.notes: Built Dashboard, Create Post, Accounts, Queue, History, Settings, and single-user login modal.

tasks.title: Deploy and verify end-to-end functionality
tasks.notes: Worker deployed to https://salt-relay-api.motionssalt.workers.dev (200 OK on /health). Pages deployed to https://salt-relay.pages.dev. D1 schema migrated and active.

tasks.title: Diagnose root cause of prefilled password and secret exposure
tasks.notes: Found hardcoded password '[REDACTED_HISTORIC_PASSWORD]' in LoginModal.tsx useState initial state, server.ts, worker/index.ts, and README.md. Verified via curl inspection of live Pages JS bundle index-BL7Ahb7N.js. Found repo was public on GitHub.

tasks.title: Remove compromised password and fallback secrets from all files
tasks.notes: Removed password from LoginModal.tsx (starts with empty string), README.md, worker/index.ts, and server.ts. Verified grep returns zero occurrences across workspace.

tasks.title: Rotate password, harden sessions, add PBKDF2 hashing, rate limiting, and restrict CORS
tasks.notes: Implemented PBKDF2/SHA-256 salted hash support with constant-time comparison. Replaced wildcard CORS with origin whitelist. Added auth_lockouts rate limiting (5 failed attempts -> 15 min lock). Added HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie session support.

tasks.title: Safely cancel test job job_971ea14d-e so it never auto-publishes
tasks.notes: Called /api/jobs/job_971ea14d-e/cancel on live worker. D1 state verified as cancelled.

tasks.title: Trace why posts stuck in pending and never published
tasks.notes: Root cause identified: worker/index.ts omitted executePublicationStep, omitted GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch, omitted webhook HMAC verification, and had an ISO string comparison bug in cron trigger. Furthermore, Zernio API requires mediaItems array rather than mediaUrls, and private release assets required a public streaming proxy.

tasks.title: Implement complete publication engine, workflow dispatch, and watchdog in Worker
tasks.notes: Built complete executePublicationStep in worker/index.ts. Added dispatchMediaWorkflow, HMAC signature validation on callback, and 15-minute Watchdog in scheduled cron handler.

tasks.title: Align Zernio publishing request payload with current API docs
tasks.notes: Updated server/zernio.ts and worker/index.ts to format mediaItems: [{ url, type }] per Zernio API v1 specifications.

tasks.title: Build streaming media proxy for private release assets
tasks.notes: Implemented GET /api/public/media/:jobId/:assetName in worker/index.ts to stream private GitHub Release assets to Zernio with zero external storage cost.

tasks.title: Add migration for job_events and auth_lockouts tables
tasks.notes: Created migrations/0002_job_events_and_auth_hardening.sql with indices for job_events and auth_lockouts.

tasks.title: Make pipeline stages and errors visible in UI with idempotent retry
tasks.notes: Updated HistoryTab.tsx to display stage badges, prominent error banners, event timelines, and one-click retry for unfulfilled destinations.

decisions: Strict preservation of KEEP list: motionssalt/bio, motionssalt/castcut, motionssalt/clipforge, and motionssalt/MotionSalt-Upscaler.
Compromised password '[REDACTED_HISTORIC_PASSWORD]' completely purged from client state, README, server, and worker.
Generated new 32-character dashboard operator password; configured PBKDF2/SHA-256 salted hashing and constant-time verification.
Stuck test job job_971ea14d-e cancelled via live API to guarantee it does not publish to real TikTok/Telegram accounts.
Worker upgraded to handle full orchestration: workflow dispatch, webhook HMAC verification, Zernio mediaItems formatting, and cron watchdog.
Added worker streaming proxy /api/public/media/:jobId/:assetName so Zernio can securely fetch media assets while the GitHub repo remains strictly private.
Visual polish remains postponed for the separate UI refinement pass per instructions.
